D5/S3/QuadraticForms/ChordalPsdCompletio.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.ChordalPsdCompletion.exists_posSemidef_completion
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/ChordalPsdCompletio.signature: theorem exists_posSemidef_completion {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsChordal) (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (hA : ∀ C : Set V, G.IsClique C → (A.submatrix (Subtype.val : C → V) Subtype.val).PosSemidef) : ∃ B : Matrix V V ℝ, B.PosSemidef ∧ ∀ i j, i = j ∨ G.Adj i j → B i j = A i j
